name: fig-to-html
description: Read a Figma .fig export directly, with no Figma app, account or API, and convert the frames you name into responsive vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Extracts structure, text, tokens, images, vector artwork and the designer's annotations; checks the result against 1:1 PNG exports; writes a design directory html-to-block-theme can build from, with the designer's notes in a file for the WordPress builder.
